Q: This is the adjuster following up on your claim for the collision you were involved in. Please state your name for the
record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you have the claim file. I'm the driver of the blue sedan.
Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving on a two-lane road in Sugar Land, heading toward a shopping center. It was daytime and the road
was dry.
Q: What happened just before impact?
A: The other car drifted into my lane while coming around a slow vehicle. I braked and steered right, but we still met
nearly head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, but it was enough to jolt me.
Q: How fast do you think you were traveling?
A: Maybe twenty-five miles an hour. I wasn't going fast.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: No. My car didn't deploy anything. I just got pushed back into the seat and then forward.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They told me I had whiplash. My neck is stiff, and I get headaches when I
turn my head quickly.
Q: Are you still experiencing those symptoms?
A: Yes, though some days are better than others. I've been doing the exercises the clinic gave me.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: Not anything that required treatment. I had some stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing like this.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I want this resolved so I can get back to normal driving and work without the pain.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
